inputs.name: counter-product
inputs.source:
---- MODULE CounterProduct ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT M
VARIABLES a,b,c,d
Init == a=0 /\ b=0 /\ c=0 /\ d=0
Stepa == a' = (IF a<M-1 THEN a+1 ELSE 0) /\ UNCHANGED <<b,c,d>>
Stepb == b' = (IF b<M-1 THEN b+1 ELSE 0) /\ UNCHANGED <<a,c,d>>
Stepc == c' = (IF c<M-1 THEN c+1 ELSE 0) /\ UNCHANGED <<a,b,d>>
Stepd == d' = (IF d<M-1 THEN d+1 ELSE 0) /\ UNCHANGED <<a,b,c>>
Next == Stepa \/ Stepb \/ Stepc \/ Stepd
Safe == a \in 0..(M-1) /\ b \in 0..(M-1) /\ c \in 0..(M-1) /\ d \in 0..(M-1)
====
inputs.config:
CONSTANT M=3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe

inputs.name: function-cube
inputs.source:
---- MODULE FunctionCube ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT N
VARIABLE nodes
Init == nodes = [node \in 1..N |-> 0]
Next == \E node \in 1..N: nodes' = [nodes EXCEPT ![node] = 1-@]
Safe == nodes \in [1..N -> 0..1]
====
inputs.config:
CONSTANT N=4
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe

inputs.name: parallel-channels
inputs.source:
---- MODULE ParallelChannels ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT N
VARIABLE chan
Init == chan = [node \in 1..N |-> [val |-> 0, rdy |-> 0, ack |-> 0]]
Send(node,message) == /\ chan[node].rdy=chan[node].ack
                      /\ chan'=[chan EXCEPT ![node].val=message, ![node].rdy=1-@]
Rcv(node) == /\ chan[node].rdy # chan[node].ack
             /\ chan'=[chan EXCEPT ![node].ack=1-@]
Next == \E node \in 1..N: (\E message \in {0,1}: Send(node,message)) \/ Rcv(node)
Safe == chan \in [1..N -> [val:{0,1}, rdy:{0,1}, ack:{0,1}]]
====
inputs.config:
CONSTANT N=2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe

inputs.name: linear-ring
inputs.source:
---- MODULE LinearRing ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT N
VARIABLE x
Init == x=0
Next == x'=IF x<N-1 THEN x+1 ELSE 0
Safe == x \in 0..(N-1)
====
inputs.config:
CONSTANT N=17
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe
